Based on my testing, here are all the qlang queries for the tasks:

M1: filter ~(and (/active) (at :email | ne null)) * (/email | lower) | sort

M2: filter ~(:user / | ((/active) | and ((user | /profile/age | ne null) !| false) | and ((user | /profile/age | type | eq ::number) !| false))) * /profile/age | :ages / | sum | div (ages | count) | round 1

M3: filter ~((/profile/country | ne null) !| false) * (/profile/country | upper | keyword) | groupBy | * count

M4: filter ~(and (/state | eq "open") (/labels | any ~(lower | eq "bug"))) | sort ~([(/priority | mul -1) /id]) | take 2 | * /id

M5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy | * count

M6: * /labels | flat | * lower | distinct | sort

M7: /dependencies | :deps / | (deps | keys) | * (:key / | {:name (key | keyword) :version (deps | at key | if (startsWith "^") ~(drop 1) ~(if (startsWith "~") ~(drop 1) ~(/)))}) | sort ~/name

M8: filter ~(or (/status | eq "paid") (/status | eq "shipped")) | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2

M9: filter ~(/status | ne "cancelled") | * {:customer /customer :total (/items | * (mul /qty /price) | sum | coalesce 0)} | groupBy ~/customer | * (:group / | {:customer (group | first | /customer) :total (group | * /total | sum | round 2)}) | vals | sort ~([(/total | mul -1) /customer]) | take 2

M10: /services | filter ~((/tls/enabled | eq true) !| false) | :filtered / | (filtered | keys) | sort | * (:name / | (filtered | at name | /host | append ":" | append ((filtered | at name | at :port | coalesce 80) | print)))

M11: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy | * count

M12: lines | filter ~(and (split " " | /1 | or (eq "WARN") (eq "ERROR")) ((split " " | drop 3 | join " ") | lower | contains "timeout")) | * (split " " | /2) | distinct | sort

M13: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | * {:dept (/1) :salary (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~/dept | * (* /salary | [sum count] | :stats / | (stats | /0 | div (stats | /1)) | round 0)
